title: Strong Duality For Linear Programming
body_html:
Strong Duality For Linear Programming

Consider the primal linear program $$ \min \langle c,x\rangle \quad\text{subject to } Ax\ge b,\ x\ge 0 $$ and its dual $$ \max \langle u,b\rangle \quad\text{subject to } uA\le c,\ u\ge 0. $$ The primal has an optimal solution if and only if the dual has an optimal solution. When optimal solutions exist, the two programs have the same value.

References

  • [MFoGT, Section 2.8, Exercise 9] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Primal-dual strong duality for linear programming.
